title: DYNAP-SE2 - Institute of Neuroinformatics
summary: The DYNAP-SE2 is a configurable mixed-signal neuromorphic processor chip manufactured using 180nm CMOS technology. It features 1024 leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neurons, 65k plastic synapses, and specialized dendrites on a 98mm² silicon area. The architecture supports real-time emulation of neural dynamics for event-based sensory processing via asynchronous routing. Published in January 2024 (IOP Neuromorph. Comput. Eng.), the chip enables prototyping of recurrent networks like winner-take-all attractors and coupled oscillators. Development boards allow testing, while stack configurations support robotic deployment.
tldr: The DYNAP-SE2 is a configurable mixed-signal neuromorphic processor with 1024 neurons designed for ultra-low power edge processing of event-based data.
